title: Display game results for all markets

requirements.summary: Display the latest declared game results for each market on the Market Lobby page
acceptanceCriteria: Each market card in MarketLobby shows the latest result (open | jodi | close) if available
If no result has been declared yet for a market, a 'Result Awaited' placeholder is shown
Results are fetched from the backend and update automatically (polling consistent with markets query)

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook to fetch all declared game results from the backend actor using the getResults method. The hook should accept an array of market IDs, poll every 30 seconds (consistent with markets query), and return results grouped by market. Cache results under the 'gameResults' query key.

Extend the MarketCard component to display the latest game result beneath the market name and schedule. Add props to accept the latest result (open number, close number, jodi). If a result is available, display it in a compact format (e.g., 'Open: 5 | Jodi: 58 | Close: 3'). If no result exists, show 'Result Awaited' as a placeholder. Style the result section to match the existing card design with appropriate spacing and text colors.

Update the MarketLobby page to fetch game results using the new useGameResultsQueries hook. Pass the list of market IDs from the fetched markets to the hook. For each market card, find and pass the most recent result as a prop. Ensure the results polling interval matches the markets query (30 seconds). Handle loading and error states gracefully.

requirements.summary: Add a dedicated 'Results' section or page accessible from the main navigation that lists all markets with their historical game results
acceptanceCriteria: A Results page or section is accessible from the app navigation
Results are listed per market in reverse chronological order
Each row shows date, market name, open number, close number, and jodi
Page is accessible to unauthenticated users

file_operations.description: Create a Results page that displays historical game results for all markets. Use the useGameResultsQueries hook to fetch results with a time range covering recent history. Render results in a table or card list grouped by market, sorted in reverse chronological order (newest first). Each entry should display the market name, date/time, open number, close number, and jodi. Include a page header with title 'Game Results'. The page should be accessible to unauthenticated users (no auth guard). Apply consistent styling with the rest of the app using Tailwind classes and the Matka theme.

Register the new Results page route in the TanStack Router configuration. Add a route at '/results' that renders the Results page component. Ensure the route is publicly accessible (no auth requirement).

Add a 'Results' navigation link to the main header navigation. Position it alongside existing links (Markets, My Bets, Wallet, Admin Panel). The link should navigate to '/results' and be visible to all users (authenticated and unauthenticated). Style it consistently with existing navigation links.

requirements.summary: Add a React Query hook to fetch all declared game results from the backend actor with polling
acceptanceCriteria: Hook fetches game results from the backend actor
Hook returns results grouped or filterable by market

file_operations.description: Create a custom React Query hook useGameResultsQueries that fetches game results from the backend actor's getResults method. Accept an array of market IDs as input and an optional TimeRange parameter. Enable automatic polling with a 30-second refetch interval. The query should be enabled only when the actor is available. Return results structured by market for easy lookup. Use the query key ['gameResults', marketIds] for proper caching and invalidation. Export the hook as the default export.
